tools.description: [Jira] Edit an issue's fields (summary, description, priority, assignee, labels, components, duedate, parent, story_points); add/remove labels. Status changes go through transition_issue.

tools.name: jira_update_sprint
tools.description: [Jira] Update a sprint: start it (state=active), complete it (state=closed), rename it, set goal or dates.

tools.name: user_complete_task

answer.description: Whatever the user asked you for: an answer, a list, a report or a decision. When asked for JSON, pass the JSON object directly, not a JSON-encoded string.

status.description: success | fail (when the task cannot be done)

tools.description: [User] End the task, done (status success) or impossible (status fail), with whatever the user asked you for (an answer, a list, a report, a decision) as the answer. The answer may be a JSON object when the user asks for one.

tools.name: user_get_address

address.description: The address id, its label (e.g. Home, Work) or default

tools.description: [User] One saved address, by id, label (Home, Work…) or default.

tools.name: user_get_last_message_from_user
tools.description: [User] The most recent message from the user.

tools.name: user_get_messages

unread_only.description: Only user messages you have not fetched yet

tools.description: [User] The conversation with the user so far, oldest first (marks user messages as fetched).

tools.name: user_get_payment_card

card.description: The card id, its label, its last four digits (also masked: **** 4242, Visa ending in 4242), its network (when it names one card) or default

tools.description: [User] One saved payment card, by id, label, last four digits (or a masked form such as **** 4242), network (when only one card has it) or default.

tools.name: user_get_profile
tools.description: [User] The user's personal details: name (first, last, full), email, phone, birthday, and the ids of their default address and payment card.

tools.name: user_get_task
tools.description: [User] The task's completion status and recorded answer.

tools.name: user_list_addresses

label.description: Only addresses with this label (case and accents ignored)

tools.description: [User] The user's saved addresses (home, work…), the default first, each also as one formatted line.

tools.name: user_list_payment_cards

network.description: Only cards of this network, e.g. visa, mastercard, amex

tools.description: [User] The user's saved payment cards, the default first: network, last four digits, holder, expiry (and whether it has passed), billing address. Full numbers are never shown.

tools.name: user_send_message

text.description: What to tell the user while you work: a question, a progress update or something they must act on

tools.description: [User] Send the user a message while you work: a question, a progress update or something they must act on. What they asked you for (an answer, a list, a report, a decision) goes in complete_task's answer.
